sn54.20:1.2: Katham bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato saṃyojanapahānāya saṃvattati ||
sn54.20:1.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgaragato vā || la-pe || || Yathā dutiyaṃ veyyākaranaṃ tathā bhikkhūnam kātabbaṃ || ||
sn54.20:1.7: Paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī ti sikkhati || || 11.
sn54.20:1.8: Evam bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi evam bahulīkato saṃyojanapahānāya saṃvattati || pa ||
